title: Bye Bye Classic Music
description:
Replaces vanilla music discs with custom music.

Created by: music_is_cool
body:
Custom music for your Minecraft world!

This resource pack replaces standard music discs with new tracks and updates their names in-game to match the audio.

Features:

New Audio: Replaces vanilla music discs with custom high-quality tracks.

Custom Titles: Disc names are updated in the game to show the correct song titles.

Optimized for 1.21: Fully compatible with the 1.21.x versions.

Created by: music_is_cool
